description.value: Strathcona Gardens Recreation Complex is a regional public facility in Campbell River operated by the Strathcona Regional District, housing an aquatic centre and ice arena under one roof. It offers pools, arenas, fitness and rehabilitation programs, and outdoor recreation programs serving residents across the region. Touring cyclists passing through Campbell River may find it a useful stop for recovery and basic services, though specific cycling amenities are not advertised on the site.
